action_rule: Existing historical audit rule: SEC acceptance + provisional 600 seconds, ceiling minute, first valid slot 09:35 through close minus 30 minutes, otherwise next regular session 09:35.
class_id_binding: Reserve one stable internal research ID per issuer; class lineage validation follows freeze and cannot silently rebind unrelated classes.
issuer_selection: Ascending numeric CIK among official SEC Q1/Q2 2025 index original 10-Q filers with at least two distinct accessions in window. First 25.
selection_inputs: Official SEC filing metadata only. No document text, market reaction, prices, returns or source-validation results.
target_selection: Earliest SEC acceptance timestamp then accession per selected CIK in window. Exactly two.
